# martingale-kit — context for AI agents

What this is: the open-source Tradingale Runner (a self-hosted martingale
sequence bot) plus the tested engine it runs on. Tradingale itself is a data
provider: it serves descriptive metrics and never places orders, holds funds,
or gives advice. Execution happens HERE, on the user's machine, with their keys.

Stack: Node >= 18, TypeScript strict, ESM ("type": "module"), zero runtime
dependencies (node:http server, no frameworks). Run TS directly with tsx via
the npm scripts. Tests: vitest.

Commands (always through npm, note the `--` separator):
  npm install
  npm run runner -- start --symbol BTC --budget 5000   # paper by default
  npm run runner -- watch | status | cycle
  npm run runner -- stop <id> [--reverse]              # cancel; --reverse also market-sells
  npm run runner -- keys                               # guided key setup -> .martingale-runner/keys.env (0600)
  npm run server                                       # web UI on PORT (default 8080)
  npm test && npm run typecheck

Env: TRADINGALE_TOKEN (required, from https://tradingale.com/settings/api;
free tier covers BTC). RUNNER_MODE=live is decided ONLY by the environment at
launch — nothing else can escalate paper to live. Live keys: KRAKEN_API_KEY/
KRAKEN_API_SECRET (crypto), ALPACA_API_KEY_ID/ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY (US
stocks; ALPACA_PAPER=true targets Alpaca's paper env). Optional:
RUNNER_PASSWORD (Basic Auth), RUNNER_STATE_DIR (persistent state dir).

Tradingale API shape (do not guess it):
  GET https://tradingale.com/api/martingale/crypto?symbol=BTC
  GET https://tradingale.com/api/martingale/stocks?symbol=AAPL
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <TRADINGALE_TOKEN>
  Response: { "data": [ { "symbol", "name", "delta_price", "nb_rounds",
  "multipliers", "initial_bet_ratio", "martingale_score", "startingale" } ] }
  (no top-level "success" field on these endpoints; calls are quota-weighted)

Engine invariants (violating these is THE classic integration bug):
  - multipliers scale QUANTITIES between levels, never dollar costs
  - a sequence plan is FROZEN at birth; nothing is recomputed later
  - exactly one sell order is active at a time (cancel, verify, then place)
  - underfunded ladders are refused with budgetMin, never distorted

Wording rules when building on this: the metrics are descriptive, never
signals/advice/forecasts; simulated results must be labeled simulated.
